purpose: Exploratory frozen PAPILA-trained external segmentation evaluation, NOT a reproduction of the original RIM-ONE DL benchmark or eligible RIM-only training leaderboard comparison.
terms: Research/education only; no redistribution or commercial use. All images/masks/IDs/weights and individual rows stay ignored/local.
partition: Complete partitioned_by_hospital/test_set, HUMS+HCSC; do not add random partition or training images.
patient_linkage: Unknown. No authoritative patient-to-image linkage verified; n_images must never be described as n_independent_patients. Image bootstrap intervals are descriptive and do not account for patient clustering.
reference: Official supplied binary PNG masks; foreground 255, background 0. Official conversion source archived for format provenance; no contour refitting, resizing or geometry repair.
prediction: Existing Predictor.predict(RGB image) only, bundle-fixed letterbox and postprocess; no reference crops, tuning, training or outcome-driven retries. CPU threads=2.
dice: Original supplied image resolution; disc includes cup. Per-image macro mean over reference-valid selected images, including invalid geometry and errors. Missing prediction masks replaced by all-empty masks for Dice; preserve statuses separately.
vcdr: Axis-aligned nonzero-mask vertical spans including endpoints; absolute error only where reference and prediction have valid nonempty disc/cup. Publish measurable numerator and reference-valid/selected denominators, plus failures and warnings.
statistics: Mean, SD, median, min,max; deterministic 2000 image bootstrap mean 95% percentile CI seed=20261104; exploratory, unclustered, no formal superiority claims.
